fusions.name: Dabbling Skim
fusions.desc: Skips a knot of locusts into the first enemy it meets for 4 water damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds, then on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Settling Deluge
fusions.desc: The swarm drops on every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 28 water damage and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Unruffled Gulp
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands. You regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Shrugged and Swallowed
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
